record.title: Acquire the authorized descending sweep in stock and derived configurations
record.intent: Observe the sampled chain over a broad source range under both software selections.
requirements: Execute the reviewed finite sweep only after fresh Linux isolation, exact source identity, current software selection and healthy full capture checks. Retain every original source request/result, acquisition transition, waveform response and preamble. A weak or constant valid waveform is an outcome, not a retry or stop condition. Framing, overload, identity, protected-material, lease or ownership failures stop with partial evidence preserved.

Seal and commit/push the stock conclusion before the derived native transition. Execute only the reviewed reversible native selection and normal reboot, prove the selected mapping and capability values in the new epoch, then run the same descending source list and acquisition settings. Do not flash an image, alter entitlement/calibration, change wiring or introduce external routing.

Preserve bounded failure cleanup, the planned source return, complete ordinary/export/run restoration and final known-safe stock software selection. Retire positively identified owned helpers, terminate capture gracefully and preserve drop statistics. Seal each actual arm separately and commit/push conclusions between experiments; never replay an ambiguous command or fabricate missing evidence.
acceptance: Actual stock and derived descending records or their exact stopped prefixes are sealed with restoration limits explicit.
